title: 2 Camarines Norte jails to get safer drinking water

blocks.text: LEGAZPI CITY — Two jail facilities in Camarines Norte will install water treatment facilities under a government partnership to improve access to safe drinking water for persons deprived of liberty (PDLs) and jail personnel. The three-year Project Aqua will provide a water treatment system, a drinking water station, and a backup generator for the Labo District Jail and Daet District Jail Annex, according to JO3 Joefrie B. Anglo, information officer of the Bureau of Jail Management and Penology (BJMP) in Bicol. “Nearly 500 inmates and jail personnel are set to benefit from the clean water initiative.
